description: Monthly principal and interest on a loan, the payment in year 1 when the loan starts interest-only, the debt service over the first 12 months and per year, and the cost of points. Payment figures differ with compounding and with how interest-only months are handled: this engine compounds monthly, pays at the end of each month and, after an interest-only period, amortizes over the full term as the Analyzer workbook does; each convention is stated in the answer. Send loan_amount, rate_pct (7.25 means 7.25% a year) and amort_years (0 means interest-only); optionally io_months and points_pct. A rate over 30% a year is refused as a likely typo.

amort_years.description: Amortization in years, e.g. 30; 0 means interest-only

io_months.description: Interest-only months at the start, e.g. 12

points_pct.description: Points as a percent of the loan, e.g. 1

rate_pct.description: Interest rate in percent per year, e.g. 7.25

name: compute_mortgage_payment
title: Mortgage payment
